meta.name: Olympo 2025
meta.description:
When a swimmer collapses at a high-performance sports center, Amaia investigates the extreme risks her fellow athletes are taking to feed their ambition.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: This Is Not Olympic Level
videos.overview: Zoe's arrival at the sports center ignites rivalry, while Olympo offers major sponsorships. Amaia pushes Núria to her limits — with severe consequences.

videos.title: Crying or Winning
videos.overview: Wracked with guilt about Núria, Amaia struggles to control her emotions. Zoe lets loose at a house party in the woods and has an unexpected hook-up.

videos.title: No, Not Again
videos.overview: Roque's sexuality costs him a place at an international rugby tournament. Unable to find Núria, a suspicious Amaia searches for evidence of doping.

videos.title: It's Best If You Stop Now
videos.overview: As Cristian returns and Olympo offers its second sponsorship, an anti-doping raid causes panic. Amaia faces accusations of betraying her fellow athletes.

videos.title: There's No Getting Through to You
videos.overview: Facing a downward spiral, HPC Pyrenees decides to get tough on the athletes. Cristian turns heads in the center as Amaia becomes increasingly lonely.

videos.title: You've Always Been My Favorite
videos.overview: Olympo flaunts its chosen athletes to the media and Amaia spots a chance to uncover the truth about Núria. Meanwhile, Zoe faces a tricky dilemma.

videos.title: It's Called Strategy
videos.overview: After a surprise return to the center, the world tournament tests take a toll on Amaia. The documentary about Roque becomes juicier than expected.

videos.title: Amaia Is Always Right
videos.overview: It's crunch time for the athletes as they compete under a cloud of doping suspicion, which intensifies doubts around the true intentions of Olympo.
